name: Wine Caddy
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: Made from high-quality, durable wood with a smooth finish that showcases the natural grain beautifully. The sturdy construction ensures reliable use and a touch of rustic charm.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions: 

- Available in two size options: 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm and 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm. 

- Thickness is 5 mm. 

- The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

- Center hole diameter: 3.2 cm ~ 1.26 in

- Side slot dimensions:

- Width: 2.43 cm ~ 0.96 in

- Slot gap: 2 cm ~ 0.79 in

- Inner gap: 1.55 cm ~ 0.61 in

 

  • Printing Technology: High-resolution UV printing technology ensures vibrant, detailed, and long-lasting images. The prints are crisp and vivid, resistant to fading, and retain clarity even with frequent use.

 

  • Printing Options: Available in single-side or double-side printing.

- Single-side printing displays the design on the front, leaving the back with a natural wood finish.

- Double-side printing showcases the artwork on both front and back for a more premium and polished look.

 

  • Functionality: This wine caddy is designed to hold a wine bottle and 2/3/4 glasses securely, making it perfect for picnics, parties, or a romantic evening. It balances neatly over the neck of a wine bottle, creating a compact and elegant serving solution.

 

  • Perfect Gift Ideas: A versatile and thoughtful gift choice suitable for all occasions—birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, or holidays. It's an excellent option for wine lovers and anyone who enjoys stylish home entertaining accessories.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wine Caddy

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
